name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
description: Flagship scheme for sustainable and responsible development of fisheries sector to boost fish production, enhance fishers income, modernize infrastructure and build robust cold-chain networks.
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
target_beneficiaries: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fish vendors, and fisheries self-help groups
benefits: Financial assistance up to 40% of project cost for general category and 60% for SC/ST/Women beneficiaries for aquaculture units, biofloc, cold storage, and modern fishing craft.

source_evidence.statement: Administered by the Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying, Government of India.
Centrally sponsored scheme implemented across marine and inland sectors of all States and Union Territories.
Fishers, fish farmers, SHGs, JLGs, and Fisheries Cooperatives engaged in fisheries and allied aquaculture activities.
Subsidies ranging from 40% to 60% of unit capital cost for approved fisheries and aquaculture activities.
source_evidence.citation: Section 4, Unit Costs and Subsidy Patterns

source_evidence.statement: Official Department of Fisheries portal hosted at dof.gov.in.
Active central implementation under total investment outlay of Rs. 20,050 crore across all states.

eligibility_criteria.limitations: Beneficiary must have required land/water body rights or vessel license for fisheries activity.

required_documents.title: Fisheries Identity / Vessel Registration / Land Document
required_documents.description: Proof of fishing activity, registered fishing vessel, or lease/ownership of pond.

required_documents.title: Bank Account Passbook
required_documents.description: Bank account details for subsidy transfer via DBT.
